message.content: Hunting for signal violations — starting with broad random sweeps before targeting edge cases.
Random sweep hit a clearance failure — now shrinking it to the minimal case.
Shrunk to a minimal emergency case — confirming it replays and inspecting the failure point.
Replay confirmed — mapping the full violation set and the states around the failure.
Multiple clearance and yellow violations cluster together — inspecting the exact transition.
Violation shows NS green while EW cut short — checking the steps just before the switch.
Preemption looks immediate — checking earlier steps to measure the truncated yellow.
I've pinpointed the instant preemption — now running a counterfactual without the emergency to prove causation.
Counterfactual is clean — assembling the final grounded report.
